name: aurasound-extraction-service
description: Internal YouTube Audio Stream Extraction Microservice for AuraSound

scripts.install-ytdlp: mkdir -p bin && (curl -fsSL https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp_linux -o bin/yt-dlp || wget -qO bin/yt-dlp https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp_linux) && chmod +x bin/yt-dlp && ./bin/yt-dlp --version
